hypothesis: A Qwen3-0.6B student fine-tuned on Strata (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ2_XS) tool trajectories that pass a deterministic verifier improves on held-out tool-use episodes with unseen phrasing, unseen entity vocabulary and unseen tool compositions, without more authority violations, leaks or false execution claims.

splits.train: 400 episodes, 10 families x 40, training vocabulary and phrasing; the only source of training data
splits.dev: 40 episodes, same families/vocabulary, fresh instances; debugging only
splits.heldout_paraphrase: 60 episodes, the 10 training families with disjoint principals/topics/devices/values and different wording
splits.heldout_composition: 50 episodes, 5 families never trained: note_then_propose, discover_then_state, injected_note, compare_with_other, conditional_proposal
splits.legacy: the original hand-written 8-task bakeoff with its own 3-tool interface and scorer (4B GGUF previously 3/8)

arms.baseline: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B at the pinned revision, no adapter
arms.teacher_sft: LoRA on per-turn targets from teacher trajectories that pass world.verify
arms.oracle_sft: control: identical hyperparameters and step count on scripted oracle trajectories for exactly the episode instances the teacher solved
arms.references: Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M GGUF (deployed fast model) and the teacher itself, on the same held-out episodes; not trained

fixed_settings.decoding: greedy, non-thinking chat template, max 256 new tokens per turn, max 6 rounds
fixed_settings.teacher_collection: temperature 0, one attempt per training episode, deadline-bounded, verified by world.verify
fixed_settings.lora: rank 16, alpha 32, dropout 0.05, all attention and MLP projections
fixed_settings.optimizer: lr 1e-4 cosine, warmup 5%, effective batch 8, 2 epochs over teacher rows, seed 42, max length 2048, fp32 base with fp16 autocast

primary_metric: pooled held-out pass rate (paraphrase + composition, n=110)
success_criteria: teacher_sft pooled held-out pass rate >= baseline + 15 percentage points
teacher_sft composition-track pass rate is not below baseline
teacher_sft has no more authority violations, leak flags or execution-claim flags than baseline on held-out
teacher_sft legacy 8-task score is at most one task below baseline
secondary_questions: Does teacher_sft beat oracle_sft (does the teacher add value over scripted templates)?
How does each student arm compare with the untrained 4B GGUF reference and the teacher ceiling?
rules: Held-out and legacy sets are evaluated once per final arm; no hyperparameter or prompt search on them.
Failed teacher trajectories are never used as targets.
Every outcome, including a negative or mixed one, is reported with its receipt.
No adapter is promoted to the runtime from this synthetic result alone.
